## SEO services

- [SEO Services](https://www.yourdomain.ca/services/): Explore every SEO service we offer Edmonton businesses: local SEO, technical SEO, on-page, content, link building, ecommerce, audits and AI search.
- [Local SEO](https://www.yourdomain.ca/services/local-seo/): Local SEO services in Edmonton. We help you rank in Google Maps and local results with Business Profile work, reviews, citations and local pages.
- [Technical SEO](https://www.yourdomain.ca/services/technical-seo/): Technical SEO in Edmonton: crawling, indexing, site structure, canonicals, structured data and page experience fixes so Google can read every page.
- [On-Page SEO](https://www.yourdomain.ca/services/on-page-seo/): On-page SEO in Edmonton: page titles, meta descriptions, headings, copy, images and internal links optimized around what your customers search for.
- [Content SEO](https://www.yourdomain.ca/services/content-seo/): SEO content writing in Edmonton: service pages, guides and articles planned around real searches and written to be helpful, original and accurate.
- [Link Building](https://www.yourdomain.ca/services/link-building/): Link building in Edmonton that follows Google's spam policies: digital PR, local partnerships, community mentions and content worth linking to.
- [Google Business Profile](https://www.yourdomain.ca/services/google-business-profile/): Google Business Profile optimization in Edmonton: verification, categories, hours, photos, posts, products and review management that supports local rankings.
- [Ecommerce SEO](https://www.yourdomain.ca/services/ecommerce-seo/): Ecommerce SEO for Edmonton online stores: category and product pages, product structured data, Merchant Center alignment and technical fixes.
- [SEO Audit](https://www.yourdomain.ca/services/seo-audit/): A full SEO audit for Edmonton businesses: technical, on-page, content, links and local search reviewed, with a prioritized fix list you can act on.
- [AI Search Optimization](https://www.yourdomain.ca/services/ai-search-optimization/): AI search optimization in Edmonton: make your content ready for Google AI Overviews, AI Mode and AI assistants using proven SEO fundamentals.
